title: Grandpa Joe's 3 Rules for a Healthy Lawn
excerpt: Forty years of lawn care, boiled down to three things that actually matter.
content: Grandpa Joe still says it takes three things: water deep and rarely (not a little every day), mow high (never below 3 inches), and feed it in the fall, not the spring. Everything else is just details.

title: Why We Still Answer Our Own Phones
excerpt: No call center, no scripts — just whichever Miller picks up.
content: We could hire a call center. We haven't, because half the time the person calling just wants to ask if it's a good week to plant tomatoes, and honestly, we like those calls.
